title: Enforce selected-provider completeness for eight fixed hourly slots

gates.name: Host hourly completeness and session probes

verify: Establish claim-linked RED against the current state: there is no selected-provider matrix proving that each of the eight fixed city-local slots is present for both target providers, especially elapsed current-day OpenWeather slots.

Use deterministic selected-city dates/timezones to project the exact six current-day slots plus next-day 00:00 and 03:00. A session may open only when all eight values come from the selected provider response.

For Open-Meteo and OpenWeather separately, remove each of the eight positions one at a time and prove entry remains on Main Display with `Почасовой прогноз еще не подгрузился`. Include OpenWeather fixtures where an elapsed current-day slot is absent.

Prove no slot is synthesized, copied from a neighboring time, read from cache/history of another provider, or borrowed from Open-Meteo for OpenWeather. The accepted W4/W5 2x4 presentation and exit flow are regression checks, not reimplemented outcomes.
Use deterministic fixtures and resettable forecast-session state; no live provider, secret, emulator/device evidence or runtime PASS claim is permitted.
Closure later requires fresh /verify PASS and /red-verify semantic-pass for FT-003-AC-001 and AC-005 Revision-2 claims; scheduler promotion remains external.

evidence_required: [FT-003-AC-001; REQ-009] Expected RED: current production behavior does not prove complete selected-provider entry for both target adapters, including elapsed OpenWeather slots. GREEN: Today opens hourly only when all eight fixed city-local positions exist in the selected provider data. Artifact: complete Open-Meteo/OpenWeather entry matrix with provider identity.

[FT-003-AC-005; REQ-009, REQ-026] Expected RED: no all-position two-provider missing-slot matrix proves unavailable behavior without synthesis. GREEN: deleting any one of eight positions for either provider keeps Main Display, shows the accepted message and never borrows/synthesizes a value. Artifact: sixteen deterministic one-missing-slot results plus elapsed-slot OpenWeather case.

T2 repeatability: fixtures fix selected-city date/timezone and provider identity, session state starts closed, each case records the decisive entry result/message and cleanup leaves no cross-run state.
purpose: Apply the accepted strict eight-slot rule to the selected provider output after the two-adapter migration without reopening hourly layout or gesture behavior.
success_outcome: Deterministic host evidence proves that Today opens exactly one eight-slot hourly session only when the selected provider supplies every fixed city-local position; any missing Open-Meteo or OpenWeather slot yields the accepted unavailable result with no synthesis or cross-provider borrowing.
anti_goals: Do not implement or modify provider HTTP adapters, selection persistence, credentials, cache/history ownership or fallback policy from TASK-019/TASK-020.
Do not redesign the accepted 2x4 hourly layout, card presentation, auto-close or gesture exit flow already owned by terminal W4/W5 records.
Do not add alternate slot schedules, partial hourly sessions, interpolation, nearest-hour matching, cross-provider reads or speculative abstraction.

forbidden_scope: weather HTTP transport, adapter parsing and Settings provider/key UI
hourly layout/presentation/gesture redesign beyond regression preservation
slot interpolation, nearest-time substitution, cross-provider fallback or mixed-provider session
new modules, dependencies, plugin/DI/event infrastructure and live external calls
stop_conditions: Stop and ask the operator before changing the fixed eight slot identities, all-or-unavailable rule or accepted message.
Stop and route to /spec-design if a new module, graph edge, public contract or state owner is required.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-003 if task identity, tier, dependency, AC ownership or material scope must change.
Stop and return upstream to TASK-020 if provider data cannot preserve the required raw city-local timestamps without adapter changes.

constraints: Forecast Sessions owns entry/session lifecycle; Weather Context owns normalized selected-provider forecast data. Neither may call the other provider or adapter directly.
The hourly projection is exactly eight fixed selected-city-local slots or unavailable; every slot must come from the selected provider response.
OpenWeather elapsed-slot absence is an ordinary incomplete result, not permission to synthesize, borrow Open-Meteo data or open a partial screen.
Existing 2x4 presentation and shared exit behavior remain unchanged and are checked only for regression.
No hard write_boundary is declared; advisory files plus forbidden scope and stop conditions define the task boundary.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-001 / REQ-009: complete selected-provider entry for Open-Meteo and OpenWeather, including required elapsed current-day positions.
FT-003-AC-005 / REQ-009, REQ-026: each missing position for each provider yields the exact unavailable message and no session.
.memory-bank/contracts/weather-provider.md#mapping-and-timezone-obligations: slot identity uses selected-city timezone rather than device timezone.
.memory-bank/contracts/weather-provider.md#failure-rules: no synthesis, partial projection, fallback or cross-provider borrowing occurs.
